Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild hyperchloremia. Red cell parameters and other biochemistry are within normal limits. These findings may suggest an acute or chronic inflammatory or infectious process, possible bone marrow involvement, or hypoxic stress. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
